Package Repository

Class MenuDAOImpl

java.lang.Object
Repository.MenuDAOImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
MenuDAO
public class MenuDAOImpl extends Object implements MenuDAO
Data Access Object implementation for menu-related database operations. Handles retrieval and persistence of MenuItem, Recipe, Ingredient, and customization data using a PostgreSQL database.
